content.short: Helmets is a thematic NFT collection on TON featuring superhero designs and ecosystem airdrop access.
content.description: Helmets (Heroic Helmets) is a popular thematic NFT collection on the TON blockchain, featuring a wide range of uniquely designed digital superhero helmets. These NFTs are frequently used as 'Telegram Gifts' that users can proudly display on their profiles, serving as a form of digital status and identity. Beyond their collectible appeal, Helmets NFTs often provide holders with exclusive access to future airdrops and community rewards within the TON gaming ecosystem. The project emphasizes the social and reward-based aspects of NFT ownership, fostering a vibrant and heroic community of supporters.
content.meta: Collect and display Heroic Helmets on TON. Your pass to ecosystem rewards on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
